hypotheses.title: The Time Warp: two OTM SPX flies bought at the close, sold the next session
hypotheses.measure: pair net per session in $ at one contract a side (and as a share of the debit), for two exit arms: the host's time-shrinking trail and a fixed 10:30 sale
hypotheses.expected: a positive mean net per session after the suite's tastytrade costs
hypotheses.sample: design 2022-05-16..2024-12-31 (~660 sessions); holdout 2025-01-02..2026-10-23 read once, only after a design pass; < 100 entered sessions = no verdict
hypotheses.rule: per arm: one-sided t > 2 on session nets, Holm across the two arms, both design time-halves positive, positive at 1.5x costs; then holdout mean > 0 with t > 2
hypotheses.mechanism: in a calm market next-day far wings are priced for a quiet session while much of the move comes overnight, so flies bought at 5% of width at the close are under-priced for the gap

hypotheses.measure: per name and arm, net as a percentage of the name's budget (cap x tranche) a year, idle days included, less a random-entry control's mean (same entries a year at random sessions' opens, same exit, cap and budget, 200 draws); arms once/chain/steps x caps 1/3/5 plus a volatility-scaled once/3
hypotheses.expected: a positive mean edge across names after 0.05% a side
hypotheses.sample: long leveraged funds in leveraged_funds.json with bars from 2011-01-03 and $20M+ median dollar volume (broker file of 2026-10-29); design 2011-01-03..2019-12-31 daily (Yahoo), holdout 2020-01-02..2026-10-28 (broker from 2022-12-29) counting only after a design pass; < 8 names or < 300 closed lots an arm = no verdict
